nodes.title: Read CSV columns

objectives.description: Read a given sales CSV and identify the amount column type without assistance.

activities: Read a small CSV example, inspect column types, then independently locate an amount stored as text.

messages.text: What will I learn in the first chapter?

response.reply: You will read a sales CSV, inspect column types, and locate an amount that was stored as text.
